idea-plugin.name: Feature Flag Reference Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Gutter icon next to every feature-flag-check call's key literal in Java/Kotlin code (isEnabled("checkout_v2"), variation("checkout_v2", false), and other common LaunchDarkly/Unleash/ConfigCat/home-grown method names), showing how many times that exact key is referenced anywhere else in the open project -- helps find orphaned flags (dead code left behind after a rollout completed) without connecting to any provider.

100% static PSI analysis, manually refreshed: the project-wide reference count is real work, so it's computed only when you explicitly run Refresh Feature Flag References (Find Action or Tools menu) -- never recalculated on every keystroke. Until the first refresh, call sites show a neutral "not yet scanned" icon instead of guessing.

Matching is by simple method name only, not a resolved SDK symbol -- works the same whether LaunchDarkly, Unleash, ConfigCat, or an in-house FeatureFlags helper is actually on the classpath. Stated honestly, not exhaustively: a differently-named wrapper around one of these SDKs isn't detected -- that's a real, documented limitation, not a bug.

Java and Kotlin in v0.1. 100% static analysis of files already open in your project -- no network call, no provider connection, no telemetry.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no popups.

action.description: Re-scan the whole open project for feature-flag-check call sites and update gutter icon reference counts
